articles.summary: AMTD Group Inc. ("AMTD Group"), AMTD IDEA Group ("AMTD IDEA") (NYSE: AMTD; SGX: HKB), AMTD Digital Inc. ("AMTD Digital") (NYSE: HKD) and The Generation Essentials Group ("TGE") (NYSE: TGE; LSE: TGE), a subsidiary of AMTD Digital, jointly (together, the "Group" or "AMTD") announce that Dao by Dorsett AMTD Singapore has been recognised with the Tripadvisor Travellers' Choice Award 2026, placing the hotel among the top 10% of properties worldwide. This achievement further cements Dao by Dorsett AMTD Singapore's position as an internationally acclaimed property. The hotel has consistently garnered top industry honours, including four consecutive TTG Travel Awards for Best Serviced Residences (Property Level), one of Asia Pacific's most prestigious travel accolades. It has also won two consecutive Tripadvisor Travellers' Choice "Best of the Best" awards, Tripadvisor's highest level of recognition.
